implementation: Adapted teammate React street rehearsal, preserving its illustrated scene, five-stage progression and evidence-card design.

sources.usage: Scene styles extracted and scoped separately in the static build.

fixture_provenance.note: Existing synthetic backend fixture; default image_url=None represented as JSON null.
Existing synthetic fallback fixture; no new coordinates, confidence or observations invented.

adaptations: Use one monotonic clock and one interval; stages advance every1800ms and stop at7200ms; pause preserves fractional elapsed time and reset clears clock and evidence modal.
Replace Live, Connected, AI-ready, captured-photo and report-delivery labels with simulation, fixture evidence and preview-only labels.
Render only available synthetic inspection points; unlock evidence cards as the stage progresses instead of showing them before the rehearsal.
Clearly label fixture coordinates, times and confidence as synthetic; no georeferencing to the separate local-meter floor simulator.
Use a native modal dialog for keyboard focus containment, Escape dismissal and return of focus to its opener.
Mount the adapted component with two existing synthetic fixtures through a new static React entry point; no backend, provider or hardware integration.
limitations: Street positions are illustrative percentages, not geographic navigation.
The sample battery is fixed display data.
No photographs are captured or submitted.
The scene is independent of FieldSight fleet and arm engine state.
No third teammate hazard fixture existed in the audited backend fixture source.
